rdfs:label: Hashtag
rdfs:comment: An ActivityStreams Link representing a hashtag — a topical keyword, conventionally prefixed with `#`, attached to an Object as a tag.
notes: The fediverse-canonical way to attach topic tags to a Note or Article. Use as a value of `as:tag`; the `name` carries the displayed string (with the `#`), and `href` is a URL clients can dereference for the topic feed. Mastodon and most ActivityPub servers treat this as the de facto standard. as:Hashtag is not part of the AS2 Recommendation's vocabulary; it is a widely-deployed extension term in the AS namespace (Mastodon, Pleroma, Misskey). Implementations must declare it in their @context.
